title: Fi Resting Time Jump After Vet Visit
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fi:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(rest_min) as rest_min by pet _time
| eventstats avg(rest_min) as baseline_rest_min by pet
| where rest_min>baseline_rest_min*1.5
| sort - rest_min
description: Uses Fi rest metrics telemetry to monitor rest time against the pet's usual baseline in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for recovery days or lethargy that stand out after stressful events, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Fi rest metrics data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It frames rest time against the pet's usual baseline so you can spot recovery days or lethargy that stand out after stressful events before it becomes annoying.
